newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases pushed by c.bank but high demand seen.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases pushed by c.bank but high demand seen.

text.p: The rouble eased after an early firming as the central banks pushed down the market which is seeking funds mainly for investing in government securities, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Apr 18 midday Apr 18 early Apr 17 close

"Rouble credits were expensive in the morning so banks preferred to sell dollars. But the dollar's dip stopped when the central bank bought dollars from banks injecting roubles into the market," one dealer said.
The central bank usually intervenes at its bid/offer rates. Its dollar bid rate today was 5,741 roubles per dollar.
Dealers said banks saw investment in T-bills more attractive at the moment compared with dollar buying.
"The general trend on the market is the same, there is a rouble shortage and it is easier for banks to sell dollars to maintain liquidity," a Bank SBS-Agro dealer said.
The central bank's first deputy chairman Sergei Aleksashenko said on Thursday it will resist market forces encouraging a real appreciation of the rouble.
He added the bank will counter the demand for roubles by widening the spread of its daily rates. But the central bank left its rates unchanged for today.
